title: 有馬記念の後に・青に染む

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the runners put their hearts and souls into the Arima Kinen, but it's Grass Wonder who ultimately stands alone at the top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Special Week is in tears, having trained so hard only to come up short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder thanks her for giving it everything she had and praises her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder has reached a new plateau. However, her journey is far from over.
